article_title: The evidence that shows today's 20-somethings really do have it worse

tasks.prompt: What conclusion does the BBC's analysis draw about today's UK 20-somethings?
options: They have reached financial independence earlier than every previous generation
Their main problem is a lack of interest in home ownership
They face the toughest start to adulthood in almost half a century across housing, work and wealth
They earn less only because they work fewer hours by choice
tasks.correct_answer: They face the toughest start to adulthood in almost half a century across housing, work and wealth
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הניתוח משווה מדדים בין דורות ומסיק שהדור הנוכחי מתמודד עם פתיחה קשה במיוחד לחיים הבוגרים.

tasks.prompt: Which statistic most directly shows delayed residential independence?
options: More than 40% of 25-year-olds live with their parents
Most 25-year-olds own two homes
Every renter spends exactly half of their income on housing
Employment among 25-year-olds has doubled since the early 1980s
tasks.correct_answer: More than 40% of 25-year-olds live with their parents
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הנתון שלפיו יותר מ־40% מבני ה־25 גרים עם הוריהם ממחיש ישירות את דחיית העצמאות במגורים.

tasks.prompt: Which three broad areas are compared across generations at age 25?
options: Travel, entertainment and sport
Education, voting and health care only
Marriage, fashion and social media
Housing, employment and wealth
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההשוואה הבין־דורית מתבססת על דיור, תעסוקה ועושר בגיל 25.

tasks.prompt: What pattern does the article identify in pay and employment for current 25-year-olds?
options: Pay has surged and unemployment has disappeared
Wages have stagnated while employment has fallen
Pay has stagnated but employment is at a record high
Both pay and employment are unchanged from every earlier decade
tasks.correct_answer: Wages have stagnated while employment has fallen
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הנתונים מצביעים על קיפאון בשכר לצד ירידה בתעסוקה, שילוב שמקשה על תחילת החיים הבוגרים.

tasks.prompt: How can high housing costs and stagnant wages reinforce each other for people in their 20s? Answer in 4–6 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את מנגנון הלחץ: חלק גדול יותר מההכנסה מופנה לדיור, החיסכון נפגע והמעבר לעצמאות או לבעלות על בית נדחה.
expected_points: Rent or mortgage costs take a larger share of limited income
Stagnant wages leave less room to absorb rising costs
Saving for a deposit or building wealth becomes harder
Young adults may remain with parents longer or delay home ownership

tasks.prompt: Why is comparing different generations at the same age more informative than simply comparing young and old people today? Answer in 4–6 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שבקרה על שלב החיים מאפשרת לבחון אם התנאים בגיל 25 השתנו, במקום לבלבל בין השפעת הגיל לבין השפעת התקופה או הדור.
expected_points: People at different ages naturally have different earnings and wealth
Comparing everyone at age 25 controls for life stage
The method reveals changes in the economic terrain faced by each generation
It supports a stronger claim about generational conditions rather than age alone

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does it mean that wages have “stagnated”?
options: They have risen much faster than housing costs
They have become impossible to measure
They have shown little or no meaningful growth
They have been replaced entirely by inherited wealth
tasks.correct_answer: They have shown little or no meaningful growth
tasks.explanation_hebrew: stagnated פירושו קפאו או כמעט לא התקדמו לאורך התקופה הנבחנת.

tasks.prompt: Write a 120–170 word summary of the article without copying sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג את מסקנת הניתוח, שיטת ההשוואה, הנתונים המרכזיים בדיור ובתעסוקה והקשר למעבר לבגרות.
expected_points: The BBC analysis compares generations at age 25 back to the early 1980s
Today's 20-somethings face unusually difficult conditions
More than 40% of 25-year-olds live with their parents
Housing costs are exceptionally high while wages have stagnated and employment has fallen
These pressures delay independence and make wealth building harder

tasks.prompt: Evaluate in 5–7 sentences whether living with parents should be treated as a cause of young adults' difficulties or as a response to them.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח טענה, להשתמש בנתוני הדיור והשכר, לשקול כיוון סיבתי חלופי ולהגיע למסקנה מנומקת.
expected_points: Present the article's evidence on parental co-residence
Connect the pattern to housing costs, wages or employment
Distinguish correlation from causation
Recognise that living at home may be an adaptive response to economic pressure
Reach a reasoned conclusion

tasks.prompt: Write 5–7 sentences identifying the strongest evidence in the article and one limitation that should be considered before generalising its conclusion.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לבחור נתון או ציר השוואה חזק, להסביר מדוע הוא משכנע, ולהציג מגבלה כגון שונות בתוך הדור או הקושי להוכיח סיבתיות.
expected_points: Choose concrete evidence such as the over-40% parental-home figure or the same-age historical comparison
Explain why the evidence supports the article's conclusion
Identify a limitation such as regional, class or individual variation
Note that broad metrics do not describe every person in their 20s
Keep the conclusion proportional to the evidence
